professionalSummary.text: Conducted discovery interviews with 24 newly signed customers at Fernway Payroll during their first month, synthesizing findings into five problem statements for the onboarding squad.
professionalSummary.witness: Interviewed 24 newly signed customers at Fernway Payroll during their first month, writing up each session and grouping the findings into five problem statements for the onboarding squad.

professionalSummary.text: Authored a requirements document for the setup checklist redesign that included problem statements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a success metric defining week-one activation as 'first test payroll completed within seven days of signup'.
professionalSummary.witness: Work sample: the requirements document for the setup checklist redesign, with the problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria and a success-metric section defining week-one activation as 'first test payroll completed within seven days of signup'.

professionalSummary.text: Led quarterly backlog prioritization with engineering and design leads, publishing the onboarding roadmap on the company wiki at the start of each quarter.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran quarterly backlog prioritisation with the engineering lead and the designer and published the onboarding roadmap on the company wiki at the start of each quarter.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated onboarding releases with support and customer success teams, drafting release notes, briefing support teams the day before releases, and updating help-center articles.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated every onboarding release with support and customer success: drafted the release notes, briefed the support team the day before and updated the affected help-centre articles.

professionalSummary.text: Participated in monthly activation reviews with the analytics team, requesting dashboard enhancements to split activation metrics by payroll provider.
professionalSummary.witness: Attended the analytics team's monthly activation review and asked for the dashboard to split activation by the payroll provider each customer was moving from.

experienceHighlights.text: Redesigned the setup checklist with the squad's product designer, resulting in a 35% increase in week-one activation.
experienceHighlights.witness: Redesigned the setup checklist with the squad's product designer, which drove a 35% jump in week-one activation.

experienceHighlights.text: Verified employment at Fernway Payroll (May 2021 to April 2024) as Product Manager through company records.
